mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, file_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_hash, content_type, category, dir_path, is_public, oss_sp, bucket_name, upload_type, upload_id, upload_status, image_process, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM mdm_fileos_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{timeFrom} AND create_time <= #{timeTo} AND id = #{id} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND category = #{category} AND file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileName}, '%') AND file_type = #{fileType} AND oss_sp = #{ossSp} AND bucket_name = #{bucketName} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND dir_path = #{dirPath} AND is_public = #{isPublic} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, tenant_code, file_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_hash, content_type, category, dir_path, is_public, oss_sp, bucket_name, upload_type, upload_id, upload_status, image_process FROM mdm_fileos_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND file_id = #{fileId} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_code, file_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_hash, content_type, category, dir_path, is_public, oss_sp, bucket_name, upload_type, upload_id, upload_status, image_process FROM mdm_fileos_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND file_id IN ( #{item} )

SELECT id, tenant_code, file_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_hash, content_type, category, dir_path, is_public, oss_sp, bucket_name, upload_type, upload_id, upload_status, image_process FROM mdm_fileos_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND file_hash = #{fileHash} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
